proposals.evidence: CDIAL 8283 purāṇa gives Bengali purāna, Assamese purāni and regional paraṇa old. These uncontracted old-adjective forms fit the family; shortened punna and purna need consonant-cluster/length review. Exact survey form paraṇã is preserved; uncertain intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 10896 explicitly places Nepali haluko and Hindi halkā under the metathesized -kk extension, stored as 10896-5 *laghukk-. The survey halka forms fit this exact branch, with intra-IA transmission unresolved. Exact survey form halka is preserved; uncertain intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 2462.2 *ēkka explicitly includes Bashkarik akh, Shina ek(h) and Lahnda hekk/hikk one. These retained-k forms select section 2, including h-bearing variants; Turner leaves emphatic strengthening versus learned replacement open. Exact survey form hek is preserved; uncertain intra-Indo-Aryan transmission remains open.
